name: Cable Man, Inc.
old_description: An OSP contractor that has built a reputation for high quality workmanship since 1972 and that prides itself in its knowledgeable staff, competitive pricing and ability to deliver quickly.
about:
Cable Man, Inc. was founded in 1972 and operates as an outside plant (OSP) construction contractor headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, with a corporate office in Biloxi, Mississippi, and additional locations in Metairie and Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and a satellite office in Alabama. The company began as a utility and telecommunications contractor serving the Gulf Coast region.

The firm provides full-service aerial and underground construction, maintenance and repair, engineering, splicing, testing, fiber optic installation, copper and coaxial cable work, cable pulling and blowing, directional boring, trenching, plowing, and utility conduit installation for gas, water, and sewer systems. It holds multi-year contracts with nationwide providers across several southeastern states.

Cable Man serves telecommunications carriers, electric utilities, broadband providers, and municipal water, sewer, and gas departments. Its customer base includes large national providers that rely on the company for infrastructure deployment and maintenance across the Gulf Coast.

The company emphasizes its knowledgeable staff, competitive pricing, and ability to deliver quickly, with a focus on quality production completed in a timely manner and a safety-first approach. It aims to build trusting relationships and a solid reputation for long-term business opportunities.
